description: hostid.v1 §2.1: a machine id and a salt -> the minted system, or null when the input is refused. The input is a JSON string, whose UTF-8 encoding is the file's bytes. Normalise it: remove the bytes 0x09, 0x0A, 0x0C, 0x0D and 0x20 (and no other character) from both ends, then lowercase A-Z. The result must be exactly 32 hex digits [0-9a-f] and not all zeros; anything else is refused. The system is "h-" followed by the first 12 lowercase hex digits of sha256(norm ++ salt), both UTF-8, no separator. A deployment always uses the salt zk2-hostid-v1 (§2.2); other salts appear only for v1's vector and the migration table (Appendix B). Each case's note says what it pins.
